findings.body: The metadata freeze still applies only when `OLD.state` is already `active` or `superseded`. A single `validated` → `active` update can therefore also rewrite `source_reporting_months`, coverage, counts, validation/reconciliation results, errors, or `validated_at_utc`; failed batches likewise retain mutable evidence. This lets activation replace the evidence that was supposedly validated, while the added test checks only edits made after activation. Freeze validation evidence during the activation transition and after failure, enforce lifecycle timestamp consistency, and cover these cases.
findings.title: Not done: immutable ingestion lifecycle

findings.body: The previous scope finding remains open. This SCHEMA branch still changes the named acceptance coverage for the later MODEL and MEMORY tasks, with corresponding plan/read metadata updates, although the permitted paths are limited to schema, warehouse migration/tests, the backend manifest, and quality gate. These edits are unnecessary for delivering the eight additive tables and should remain with their owning tasks or a separately approved planning change.
findings.title: Remove out-of-scope changes to future MODEL and MEMORY tasks
